usage: The word 電路 refers to the path or system through which electric current flows.
It is a noun used to describe an actual physical or conceptual circuit in electronics or physics.
You can use 電路 to talk about simple circuits, like a battery and a bulb, or complex ones, like computer circuits.
In sentences, 電路 can be the subject, object, or part of a compound noun.
Electric circuit diagrams are often called 電路圖.
